# this = combat. 13 expiring markers, marker k for k days; ck3xbl_cday_marks_value counts the expired ones.

# One army slot: $TAG$ = army tag register, $LEVY$ = levy survivors, $Tk$ / $Sk$ = MaA type index / survivor share of max per mille.
ck3xbl_st_store_slot_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:$TAG$ > 0 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = ck3xbl_armies
			limit = { has_variable = ck3xbl_aid var:ck3xbl_aid = root.var:$TAG$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_levy value = root.var:$LEVY$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_m1_idx value = root.var:$T1$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_m1_share value = root.var:$S1$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_m2_idx value = root.var:$T2$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_m2_share value = root.var:$S2$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_m3_idx value = root.var:$T3$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_m3_share value = root.var:$S3$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_m4_idx value = root.var:$T4$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_m4_share value = root.var:$S4$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_m5_idx value = root.var:$T5$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_m5_share value = root.var:$S5$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_m6_idx value = root.var:$T6$ }
			set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_t_m6_share value = root.var:$S6$ }
		}
	}
}

# this = army with an end state, root = the player (the fix): levies cut down to the slot
# survivors (else the steering-start levies; levies only go down, CK3's extra kills are logged as ck3xbl_st_levy_excess), then
# every MaA type set exactly: the steering-start state first, then the slot pairs, which win. ST|FIX.
ck3xbl_st_fix_army_effect = {
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_levies_now value = { value = army_size every_army_maa_regiment = { subtract = maa_current_troops_count } min = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ck3xbl_t_levy }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_levy_target value = var:ck3xbl_t_levy }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_default value = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_levy_target value = var:ck3xbl_td_levy }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_default value = 1 }
	}
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_levy_excess value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:ck3xbl_st_levies_now > scope:ck3xbl_st_levy_target }
		deplete_army_by_percentage = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_levies_now subtract = scope:ck3xbl_st_levy_target divide = scope:ck3xbl_st_levies_now }
	}
	else = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_levy_excess value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_levy_target subtract = scope:ck3xbl_st_levies_now } } }
	ck3xbl_st_restore_default_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ck3xbl_t_m1_idx var:ck3xbl_t_m1_idx > 0 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_maa_idx value = var:ck3xbl_t_m1_idx }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_maa_share value = var:ck3xbl_t_m1_share }
		ck3xbl_st_set_maa_type_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ck3xbl_t_m2_idx var:ck3xbl_t_m2_idx > 0 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_maa_idx value = var:ck3xbl_t_m2_idx }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_maa_share value = var:ck3xbl_t_m2_share }
		ck3xbl_st_set_maa_type_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ck3xbl_t_m3_idx var:ck3xbl_t_m3_idx > 0 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_maa_idx value = var:ck3xbl_t_m3_idx }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_maa_share value = var:ck3xbl_t_m3_share }
		ck3xbl_st_set_maa_type_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ck3xbl_t_m4_idx var:ck3xbl_t_m4_idx > 0 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_maa_idx value = var:ck3xbl_t_m4_idx }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_maa_share value = var:ck3xbl_t_m4_share }
		ck3xbl_st_set_maa_type_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ck3xbl_t_m5_idx var:ck3xbl_t_m5_idx > 0 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_maa_idx value = var:ck3xbl_t_m5_idx }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_maa_share value = var:ck3xbl_t_m5_share }
		ck3xbl_st_set_maa_type_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ck3xbl_t_m6_idx var:ck3xbl_t_m6_idx > 0 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_maa_idx value = var:ck3xbl_t_m6_idx }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_maa_share value = var:ck3xbl_t_m6_share }
		ck3xbl_st_set_maa_type_effect = yes
	}
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = ck3xbl_st_unindexed
		value = {
			every_army_maa_regiment = {
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						is_maa_type = huscarl
						is_maa_type = landsknecht
						is_maa_type = longbowmen
						is_maa_type = goedendag
						is_maa_type = gendarme
						is_maa_type = chasseur
						is_maa_type = picchieri
						is_maa_type = praetorian
						is_maa_type = caballero
						is_maa_type = monaspa
						is_maa_type = cataphract
						is_maa_type = hobelar
						is_maa_type = schiltron
						is_maa_type = metsanvartija
						is_maa_type = horse_archers
						is_maa_type = ayyar
						is_maa_type = mubarizun
						is_maa_type = mulaththamun
						is_maa_type = archers_of_the_nile
						is_maa_type = paiks
						is_maa_type = druzhina
						is_maa_type = hussar
						is_maa_type = horn_warrior
						is_maa_type = bush_hunter
						is_maa_type = shomer

# this = regiment: current = max x scope:ck3xbl_maa_share / 1000, up or down (share divided first to keep the product small).
ck3xbl_st_set_maa_share_effect = {
	change_maa_troops_count = {
		value = scope:ck3xbl_maa_share
		divide = 1000
		multiply = maa_max_troops_count
		subtract = maa_current_troops_count
	}
}
